test.create_query: CREATE TABLE agg_in_order_if_null_map (k UInt32, x Nullable(Float64), cond UInt8) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO agg_in_order_if_null_map SELECT intDiv(number, 8), if(number % 17 = 0, NULL, toFloat64(number % 1000)), number % 3 != 0 FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
test.query: SELECT k, sumIfOrDefault(x, cond) FROM agg_in_order_if_null_map GROUP BY k SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT k, avgIfOrDefault(x, cond) FROM agg_in_order_if_null_map GROUP BY k SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
